info.name: Smart Campus - Tickets API
info.description: Incident tickets API (smart-campus-backend). Set `baseUrl` if your app runs on a different host/port. After Create Ticket, copy `id` into `ticketId` for the other requests. PATCH endpoints require `actorRole` ADMIN or TECHNICIAN.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Projector not turning on in Lab 3",
  "description": "Power LED is off; checked power cable and outlet.",
  "category": "PROJECTOR",
  "priority": "HIGH",
  "preferredContact": "email:user@example.com",
  "resourceId": 42,
  "locationText": "Building A, Floor 2, Lab 3",
  "createdByUserId": 1001
}

request.description: POST /api/tickets — creates a ticket with status OPEN.
GET /api/tickets/{id} — set `ticketId` in the collection Variables tab (or paste the id from Create Ticket response).
PATCH /api/tickets/{id}/assign-technician — sets assignedTechnicianId. Admin or technician only.
PATCH /api/tickets/{id}/status — update status (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED, REJECTED). For REJECTED, include rejectionReason. Admin or technician only.
PATCH /api/tickets/{id}/resolution-notes — appends resolution notes. Admin or technician only.
